profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. Its website describes it as providing AI automation for the most important business processes at the world's largest organizations, and states that it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site presents a unified platform for orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people, covering process automation, giving AI reliability and control, and modernizing legacy applications with AI. It lists uses in accounts payable and accounts receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing, contracts and supplier data, audit workflows and attestations, case intake and resolution, procure-to-pay, order intake and fulfillment, and employee, customer, and vendor onboarding, which the site says cuts time by up to 50%. The company also describes no-code building of AI-powered apps with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. It states that it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The company's litigation record shows 152 cases in Virginia.
